implementation.input: A complete projected single-sided planar face with one simple straight-edged loop and at most one strictly nested hole, no pcurves, bounded edge and vertex counts, and mutually consistent chain/use identities.
implementation.behavior: Classifies in raw coordinates as inside, outside or boundary with explicit tolerance; validates connectivity, identities, finite endpoints, coplanarity, curve/vertex consistency, nonintersecting rings and nesting. Unsupported, invalid, ambiguous, off-plane or resource-exceeding inputs refuse without changing the output. Does not apply transform, units, ACIS containment flags, or general B-rep semantics.

independentEvidence.result: The independent decoder matches all 8 faces, 10 ordered loops, 36 oriented coedges and the identities and coordinates of their 12 distinct vertices to 1e-10; no selected coedge has a pcurve and all supporting curves are straight.
independentEvidence.kernel: Prior BRL-CAD 7.24 selected-ray observations on an OCCT-generated normalized STEP intermediary: six rim hits and hole/outside misses; source helper agrees. This is an independent geometry kernel but not an independent source-native modeler or unmodified boundary bridge.

validation.normal: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_graph_preservation_tests -j2; ctest --test-dir build-gcc -R ^libdxfrw_graph_preservation$ --output-on-failure: PASS 1/1
validation.addressSanitizer: cmake --build build-asan-custom --target libdxfrw_graph_preservation_tests -j2; ctest --test-dir build-asan-custom -R ^libdxfrw_graph_preservation$ --output-on-failure: PASS 1/1
validation.controls: Generated triangle/hole, outer/hole boundary, boundary tolerance, reordered loops, off-plane, missing loop, pcurve, broken ring, vertex mismatch, curved edge, double-sided face, nonfinite tolerance, self-intersection, disjoint/touching rings, loop budget, and corrected retry.
validation.sourceProbeResult: 8 peer ray classifications and one source edge midpoint pass; pcurve mutation refuses without changing result; corrected same-object retry passes.
validation.fixturePolicy: No drawing, SAB, peer binary or derived fixture committed.

limitations: This closes P7-G only for the selected source-associated straight-planar boundary utility profile, not DWG 3D output, native producer/consumer support, arbitrary polygon robustness, native kernel trim semantics, curves, pcurves, multiple holes, or general ACIS support.
